name: Canvas Engine
description: Core infinite canvas engine (~1200 lines). Manages world-to-screen coordinate transform (screenX = worldX * scale + panX), pan via left/middle-click drag, zoom via mouse wheel (cursor-centered, 0.1x-5x range, lock toggleable), grid rendering (dots/grid/none patterns via offscreen canvas), plugin card lifecycle (add/remove/minimize/terminate/reopen/focus with z-order stacking), snap-to-grid (28px), plugin creation (Terminal, Explorer/Dev, Git, Markdown), fit-all viewport calculation, animated pan (ease-out cubic 300ms), canvas status bar with zoom/lock/workspace name, plugin list panel (lower-left), arrange panel (auto-arrange + tile plugins with custom WxH), save state serialization, and right-click context menu on empty canvas space.

dependencies.usage: Creates PluginCard instances for each plugin, manages drag/resize/minimize
Combined split-pane explorer (FileExplorer + MonacoEditor) in a single card
Instantiated inside git plugin cards, uses GitState type
Right-click menu on empty canvas area (new terminal/explorer/git/markdown)
Instantiated inside markdown plugin cards, uses MarkdownState type

fields.name: plugins
fields.description: Array of saved plugin cards with uuid, title, position, dimensions, open state, optional editor/markdown/git state

fields.name: zOrder
fields.description: UUID stack — last element is topmost card

fields.name: panX
fields.description: Horizontal pan offset in screen pixels

fields.name: panY
fields.description: Vertical pan offset in screen pixels

transforms.world_to_screen: screenX = worldX * scale + panX; screenY = worldY * scale + panY
transforms.screen_to_world: worldX = (screenX - panX) / scale; worldY = (screenY - panY) / scale

interactions.name: pan
interactions.trigger: Left/middle mouse button drag on canvas

interactions.name: add_terminal
interactions.behavior: Creates PluginCard with TerminalPlugin, snap-to-grid positioned

interactions.name: add_explorer
interactions.behavior: Creates PluginCard with ExplorerPlugin, opens root directory

interactions.name: add_git
interactions.behavior: Creates PluginCard with GitPlugin, single-instance enforced

interactions.name: add_markdown
interactions.behavior: Creates PluginCard with MarkdownPlugin, no path needed

interactions.name: fit_all
interactions.behavior: Calculates bounding box of all cards, sets zoom/pan to fit viewport with padding

interactions.name: auto_arrange
interactions.behavior: Tiles all open cards in a grid layout with configurable columns

interactions.name: animate_pan
interactions.behavior: Ease-out cubic interpolation over 300ms to target pan position

callbacks.onStateChange: () => void — fired when plugin positions change (drag end, resize end, add/remove)
callbacks.onTerminalsChanged: (items[]) => void — terminal plugin list for TopBar menu
callbacks.onExplorersChanged: (items[]) => void — explorer plugin list for TopBar menu
callbacks.onGitChanged: (items[]) => void — git plugin list for TopBar menu
callbacks.onMarkdownChanged: (items[]) => void — markdown plugin list for TopBar menu
callbacks.onLockToggle: () => void — zoom lock toggled from status bar
